Genus: Italian regional stillbirths at the turn of the nineteenth century, relating seasonal agricultural workload to male and female stillbirths while modelling MISREPORTING. A historical FDT-era design that confronts the measurement problem head-on -- one of the very few of its kind in the frame.

Dissertation applying the Bongaarts proximate-determinants model to below-replacement Korea and the US. Tests whether the accounting frame B.5 sits inside still holds at low fertility, which is the scope doc's own prediction about where the effect vanishes.
Descriptive Serbian birth trends.
Perinatal mortality case-control, Bahir Dar; preprint.
Tertiary-hospital stillbirth causes, central India; weak venue.
Stillbirth risk factors during the Yemen conflict; a conflict setting, though the design is a risk-factor cross-section rather than a shock estimate. Preprint.
NEJM: fetal death risk after 2009 H1N1 infection versus vaccination, Norwegian registries. The pandemic-infection channel with a clean comparison, and the modern analogue of the 1918 anchors.
UK national cohort of H1N1 in pregnancy.
Male excess in stillbirth risk, meta-analysis of 30 million births. Bears on the sex-ratio consequence of loss and on A.10.

Review of interventions screening and managing infections in pregnancy and their effect on stillbirth. INTERVENTION evidence on the infection channel -- the closest thing in the frame to experimental support for B.5's infection driver.
PCOS pathogenesis spanning infertility and early loss; no abstract, margins not separated.
Algorithm for identifying pregnancies in electronic records; determines whether losses are observable at all in claims data.

Eastern Uganda 1982-2011 stillbirth and neonatal trends from pregnancy histories in an HDSS. A three-decade series in a high-fertility setting, which is the regime where B.5 predicts its effect should bind.
Surgery for uterine anomalies in recurrent miscarriage.

Abortion-prone MOUSE matings. Wall 7 firing inside the top-ranked slice, which is why the wall was stated in advance.
Phnom Penh maternity-hospital stillbirth determinants.

Advances in Life Course Research: whether experiencing a pregnancy loss changes subsequent fertility DESIRES AND INTENTIONS. A stated-intention outcome, so it pools only with other stated-intention estimates, and it is the behavioural half of the replacement question.
Maternal chemical exposure and fetal death, JECS cohort; cross-file B.2.
Results-based financing intervention and stillbirth.
Sao Paulo multidisciplinary stillbirth case-control.
Maternal AND paternal age against time-to-pregnancy and miscarriage, Rotterdam cohort. Separates the conception and survival margins across both parents' ages.
